closed_trade_count.question: How many selected closed trades are in the denominator?

net_pnl.question: What did the selected closed trades make or lose after recorded costs?

win_rate_pct.question: What share of selected closed trades finished net positive?

expectancy_net_per_trade.question: What was average net P/L per selected closed trade?

profit_factor_after_cost.question: How much net-positive P/L was observed per unit of net-negative P/L?

payoff_ratio_after_cost.question: How large was the mean net winner relative to the mean net loser?

average_realized_r.question: What was average realized R when every selected trade has planned risk?

closed_trade_balance_max_drawdown.question: What was the largest peak-to-trough drop in the closed-trade balance path?
closed_trade_balance_max_drawdown.source: closed-trade balance path; no floating P/L or cashflow

closed_trade_balance_max_drawdown_pct.question: What was the largest closed-trade balance drawdown as a percent of its prior peak?
closed_trade_balance_max_drawdown_pct.source: closed-trade balance path; no floating P/L or cashflow

max_loss_streak.question: What was the longest consecutive net-loss streak in sequence order?
max_loss_streak.formula: max consecutive net_pnl_i < 0; breakeven resets streak

starting_balance.question: What run starting balance anchors this closed-trade balance path?

ending_closed_trade_balance.question: What is starting balance plus selected closed-trade net P/L?
